content: Hi, I'm having trouble logging into my account. It says my password is incorrect but I'm sure I'm using the right one.
I'm sorry to hear that! Let me help you get back into your account. Have you tried using the 'Forgot Password' option to reset it?
Yes, I tried that. The reset link never arrives in my email. I've checked spam too.
I understand how frustrating that must be. Let me check your account details. Could you provide the email address associated with your account so I can look into this?
It's john.doe@email.com. I really need access urgently, I have an important deadline today.
I appreciate you sharing that. I can see your account in our system. Let me send a manual password reset from here. You should receive it within 2 minutes. I'll stay on this with you.
Thank you, I appreciate the help. I'll wait for the email.
